caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a man standing on a rectangular platform. The man is dressed in a dark blue coat with red trim, a vest decorated with white stars, a bowtie, and red-and-white vertically striped pants. He wears a tall gray hat with a blue band featuring white stars. His facial hair consists of white sideburns and a long pointed beard, and he appears to be holding a round object in his right hand. Next to his left leg is a green umbrella, and near his right foot is a brown bag or suitcase marked with the letters "U.S." The platform he stands on is painted to resemble wooden planks in off-white, and its front face is decorated with an image of a golden eagle with widespread wings against a red background. Above the eagle, there are blue banners with the words "UNCLE" on the left and "SAM" on the right. The side of the platform is labeled "BANK." The drawing is rendered in a realistic style with colors including red, blue, white, gray, brown, green, gold, and black.
title: Toy Bank: Uncle Sam
